text: Come, let us sing for joy to the Lord; let us shout aloud to the Rock of our salvation.
and extol him with music and song.
the great King above all gods.
and the mountain peaks belong to him.
and his hands formed the dry land.
let us kneel before the Lord our Maker;
and we are the people of his pasture, the flock under his care. Today, if you hear his voice,
as you did that day at Massah in the desert,
though they had seen what I did.
I said, “They are a people whose hearts go astray, and they have not known my ways.”
